evidence_rules: compare is strict by default: a required field missing from one or both results fails
results must have identical field sets and the same harness revision
every row must carry slug, stage, argv, exit, stdout_sha256, stderr_sha256, corpus_tree_sha256 (and work_tree_sha256 for replay, extract and audit rows)
a run records harness_unchanged, harness_frozen_snapshot, harness_committed, binary_unchanged and whether the live source changed; a changed executing snapshot or binary makes the run exit 3
--allow-legacy-format compares older results, reports evidence_complete=false and exits 2, never 0
every compare file records the comparator's own harness hash
